claude_proposed_widenings.name: weaponFilter.specific_item
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing weapon filter only distinguishes melee vs. ranged weapons, but this item's +2 attack and damage bonuses apply only when attacking with this specific magic weapon.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_bonus_action_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can grant an extra action, but not permission to make exactly one weapon attack as a Bonus Action each turn. Encoding this as grant_extra_action would be false, because a Bonus Action attack is not an additional action.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "In addition, you can make one attack with it as a Bonus Action on each of your turns."
